New Employee Onboarding Guide

Welcome to Moa Logistics.
This document provides a step-by-step guide to your first two weeks here ▶

For inquiries, please contact Mr. Joonho Byun in the Human Resources department.
Mr. Seojin Um will assist you with setting up the development environment.
On the first day
Upon arrival, you will first obtain your access card at the reception desk on the 1st floor.

Once you receive the access card, you will register it with Jun-ho Manager.
The seat is next to the early morning team, and Ms. Eum Se-jin will also sit in the same row.
We will have lunch together as a team.

Day two
On the second day, I will spend the entire day at the site.
For the disembarking work, I will wear safety shoes and observe.
Do not approach or speak to workers who are actively working.

The experience report will be submitted to the team leader for approval.
Once reviewed, it will be forwarded to Jun-ho Manager.
First week

New Moar Logistics employees will complete a task list called "Launchpad" during their first week.
The first item on the Launchpad is to log in to the wiki and register for the internal messaging system.
Company-wide announcements and casual conversations will take place on the "Hearth" channel.
I'll leave a brief introduction on the "Hearth" channel.

Step 2 involves attending the "Guide System" training program.
You will create a daily schedule for the guide system yourself.
The practice screen will not be posted on the "Hearth" channel.

The report does not need to be lengthy.
Once all the tasks are completed, you will start working on real-world projects from the second week.
Your first practical work will involve code review with Mr. Eumseojin.
The results of the code review will be shared on the team's Slack channel.

Please feel free to contact Junho Manager if you have any questions.
Finally, please leave a brief comment about your experience in the "Mockfire" channel.
